buffer_reuse_safeguard.host_buffers: Separate per-layer staging segments for slot IDs and destination IDs.
buffer_reuse_safeguard.completion_events: One event per host buffer per layer, recorded on the transfer stream after its H2D copy.
buffer_reuse_safeguard.reuse_rule: Synchronize that buffer's event before rewriting its layer segment.
buffer_reuse_safeguard.stream_rule: The supported mode uses the main single stream; runtime checks reject a different hit-copy stream.
buffer_reuse_safeguard.cleanup_rule: session_loop synchronizes the stream at token end; error cleanup drains it before staging and event destruction.

performance_ab.interpretation: The dispatch metric fell, but combined decode throughput did not improve in this six-run set. The third pair slowed in both modes; temperature, power state and background load were not recorded. This set does not establish a repeatable throughput gain.
limitations: One prompt and one Windows AMD GPU were tested.
The fenced and overlap runs were interleaved; temperature, power state and background load were not recorded.
The dispatch metric includes source preparation and activation quantization, not only CPU expert computation.
The performance runs used no Ring trace instrumentation.

fenced_followup.note: One sequential confirmation run, not a paired performance estimate.

access_trace_smoke.release_event_scope: Ring slot release fence; separate hit-list H2D completion events are still recorded and awaited before host-buffer reuse.
access_trace_smoke.note: Access tracing queries release events and adds overhead; this smoke verifies the selected path, not performance.
